title: A CQRS command deciding through an aggregate, its handler and spec, and an optional route

module.description: The feature directory under src/ holding the aggregate; its module is created when absent.

name.description: The command, a verb phrase: focus-rig. Also the aggregate's method, focusRig.

aggregate.description: The aggregate it decides through, as the aggregate generator named it: rig.

event.description: The event its decision applies, a new class: RigFocused.

route.description: An idempotent route, its one parameter the aggregate's id: v1/rigs/:rigId/focus.
